answer: Sybil resistance here is a locked work-bond: an agent may occupy only one public mesa and must keep a non-transferable stake locked across a full settlement tide. Peers re-execute the bonded task against that same mesa and attest only if the output matches the live work log and the stake is still locked. A hollow replica—identical wording, no separate stake—cannot hold a second mesa or fund a second tide, so it fails attestation. Each alias therefore pays its own bond, wait, and peer-checked work; unpaid copies are refused.
